built: sim/systems/accuracy8.gd: Accuracy8.mult(w,e,s,t) multiplies the weapon accuracy in Combat._fire (one line after Wounds.acc_mult + one preload). Same single w.rng hit roll. Content content/g7/rules_g8_accuracy.json rules.accuracy8 (all PROVISIONAL). Saved entity ints a8t/a8k/a8l (sight picture). Env ACCURACY8_OFF=1 (old path) / ACCURACY8_SHADOW=1 (computed, returns 1.0) for A/B only.
factors_reused_not_duplicated: suppression/pinned (Status.accuracy_mult 0.8/0.5), fatigue + rank/traits (Morale.acc_mult -> Fatigue/Veterancy), arm wounds (Wounds.acc_mult), dead sensors (Status), G6 hooks (cohesion, loadouts, designation, auras, airdef). Senses7 light / smoke clouds / silhouette numbers / optics_defs / thermal_defs reused.

factors_new.range: eff = range x eff_frac[class] (small_arms 0.6, sniper 0.8, at 0.6, ...); inside x(1+0.15(1-d/eff)); past it down to x0.55 at max range (pow 1.5)
factors_new.flight_time: tf from rounds8 v0/k (exp drag); x1/(1+0.15 tf^2); crossing lead error x1/(1+(0.3 speed tf |sin| / half_size)^2), speed = def speed x mvm x 1.8 m/tile
factors_new.shooter_moving: infantry x0.5 + aim restarts; stabilised vehicle (heavy/medium armour, ifv, def.stab) x0.85; unstabilised x0.55 + aim restarts; Machine x0.75
factors_new.target_moving: inf x0.9, vehicle x0.92 (+ lead error)
factors_new.sight_picture: aim time on this target since first shot (lost after 6 s / new target): iron snap 0.65 -> steady 1.05 over 2 s; optics 0.7 -> 1.15 over 1.2 s; vehicles/buildings/Machine fire control 0.8 -> 1.05 over 1.5 s
factors_new.visibility: night lerp(0.35,1,light) (thermal/NVG/Machine: max(0.9,light)); smoke on line x0.25 (thermal x0.85); past shooter's own sight x0.8..x0.75; infantry target silhouette^0.5 (prone 0.45, crouch 0.7, forest 0.6); weather w.cfg.weather (fog 0.6, dust 0.7, rain 0.85...; no weather system exists)
factors_new.under_fire: fresh hit within 2.5 s (last_hit_tick) inf x0.7 / veh x0.9; concussion daze e.b8d > tick x0.55 (BLAST8 asked via board need concussion_daze to write b8d; absent = no effect)
factors_new.posture: infantry static: prone x1.12 or braced (garrison / in_cover / deployed) x1.10, the larger
factors_new.training: tier by def.training or prefix: militia 0.88, regular 1.0, veteran 1.06 (g7_cn, a_sniper, b_marksman), elite 1.12 (g7_sent, g7_op_)
factors_new.skipped_x1: indirect, guided, air shooter or air target (Airdef rules), melee/flame/demolition/crush/torpedo

misses_fly_on: NOT added: the existing code has no stray-hit path for direct fire (a miss scatters the tracer end +-0.6 and Damage.near_miss suppresses enemy infantry within 1.5 of the target; only CIWS has straight streams). Adding stray hits needs damage.gd (LETHAL8B) + an extra rng draw; left for ORCH to decide.
